latest.title: On the Gromov product and its generalization in partial metric spaces
latest.abstract: The first aim of this article is to extend the notion of the Gromov product to the class of partial metric spaces. A relation between $δ$-hyperbolicity of a partial metric space and $δ$-hyperbolicity of metric spaces endowed with the metrics defined via that partial metric is also established. The second one is to analyze the Gromov product in the wide class of metric spaces in which metrics are defined via Chebyshev sets. Midpoint mappings in this class of spaces will be also examined.
latest.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
latest.workSummary: 把 Gromov 积推广到部分度量空间，比较其双曲性与诱导度量双曲性，并研究 Chebyshev 集定义的度量。
latest.breakthrough: 整理扩展定义与已有度量结构之间的关系。
latest.limitations: 新定义层面的推广不自动带来经典 GH 或曲率问题的新结果。 当前为摘要级分析，技术细节与结论须回查原文。
latest.priorityReason: 目前主要为特定广义度量类的形式推广，对核心问题的新增应用尚不清楚。
latest.lowPriorityReason: 目前主要为特定广义度量类的形式推广，对核心问题的新增应用尚不清楚。 此为本课题组阅读顺序判断，不是论文质量结论。
